title: Asymptotics for a class of parametric martingale posteriors

split.decision: Three sample sizes x5000 datasets per split. Original public val RNG, independent hidden test RNG, cross-n pairing preserved; observations only.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical metric only; no full reference run for conversion.

allowed_changes: Predictive-resampling implementations, truncation/tail approximations, direct integration or other numerical inference algorithms may change while approximating that posterior.
Sample count and numerical solver settings may change; an auxiliary loss can improve approximation but cannot redefine the predictive law or posterior.
When retaining the supplied hybrid predictive resampling, changing only B=2000, T=50 or sampler seed 382 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Approximate the specified bivariate-normal parametric martingale posterior and its central 95% intervals, evaluated by the unchanged scaled interval score.
The predictive family N(mu,Sigma), sample-mean/unbiased-covariance initialization, natural-gradient update Z and learning rule 1/N define the target limiting posterior.
The mu1/s1/s12 parameters, 2.5%/97.5% quantiles, independent observed datasets, fixed n grid and sqrt(n)-scaled interval score remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace this posterior with a conventional Bayesian prior, generic frequentist interval or changed predictive model/learning rule to obtain easier coverage.
No true design parameters as fitted values, cross-dataset pooling or modification of the interval score.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
